plan.summary: This 4-week block starts the 12-week off-camp parent cycle for boxing with a simple build-focused approach: power first, then main strength, then practical accessories. With only one S&C session per week and minimal home equipment, the goal is to raise general strength and explosive output without adding fatigue that hurts boxing practice. Week 1 is used to establish training maxes for future percentage work on the main lift, and the main training block starts in Week 2.

phaseOverview.label: Building
phaseOverview.focus: Build general lower-body force, basic explosive ability, and trunk strength with simple high-value work.

phaseOverview.label: Intensifying
phaseOverview.focus: Push the main strength work forward while keeping power work crisp and recoverable.

phaseOverview.label: Expressing
phaseOverview.focus: Keep strength in place and express it through faster, sharper jumps and throws with lower fatigue.

exercises.name: Countermovement Jump
exercises.notes: Jump as high as you can and land softly. Reset between reps so every jump stays sharp.

substitutionOptions.name: Squat Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if ceiling space or setup makes countermovement jumps awkward.

substitutionOptions.name: Box Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Use a low safe box and step down between reps.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat
exercises.notes: Warm up with a few progressively heavier sets, then work up to your hardest clean set of 3-5 reps with solid depth and control. This sets your baseline for future percentage work.

strengthAssessment.prompt: Warm up progressively, then work up to your heaviest clean set of 3-5 reps. Log the load and reps so the app can estimate your training max.

substitutionOptions.name: Double Dumbbell Front Squat

substitutionOptions.name: Kettlebell Front Squat

exercises.name: Push-Up
exercises.notes: Leave 1-2 reps in reserve and keep the body straight. Elevate the hands if needed to keep clean reps.

substitutionOptions.name: Dumbbell Floor Press

substitutionOptions.name: Incline Push-Up
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if full push-ups are not yet clean for the full set range.

exercises.name: One-Arm Dumbbell Row
exercises.notes: Pull the elbow back hard and pause briefly at the top. Keep the torso quiet and avoid twisting.

substitutionOptions.name: Chest-Supported Dumbbell Row

substitutionOptions.name: Resistance Band Row
